newsitem.title: FINLAND: Amer reverses gains after expected loss.
newsitem.headline: Amer reverses gains after expected loss.

text.p: Shares in Finnish sporting goods group Amer-yhtyma Oy fell after it reported an expected deep loss, reversing speculative gains built up ahead of Thursday's announcement, brokers said.
At 1155 GMT, Amer traded at 102.0 markka, down 4.00 markka or just under four percent. Volume was a moderate four million markka.
"The loss was about what was expected but someone was buying earlier this week and now that bubble burst," one broker said. @
Amer fell to a 206 million markka January-August loss before extraordinary items from a 36 million profit.
The median of analysts' forecasts had been for a 195 million markka loss, in a 145-224 million markka loss range.
